pages.why: The new "In this post" entries are anchors to the headings; the old ones are scroll buttons, not links. The committed CMS export (migration/framer-cms/blog.csv) gives the category shown; the published page shows another. The export is the source of truth, so it is listed here, not edited by hand; a maintainer can confirm which is right. Framer also has a hidden "Section" text at 1200px.
